input.null_pointer_behavior: Null input returns -1 at declared input lengths 0 and 46.

output.meaning: Maximum source-to-sink flow value, summed over final disconnected block components.

algorithm_profile.method: Bounded deterministic PEIBFS-inspired adaptive bottom-up merging: solve blocks, score boundaries, merge components, and solve each enlarged component with a fresh EIBFS run.
algorithm_profile.phase_one: Solve each block in ascending ID order from original capacities with the two-forest EIBFS solver.
algorithm_profile.merge_tags: For each block, enumerate all source-side masks and choose the numerically smallest mask among minimum cuts; tag its vertices source-side or sink-side.
algorithm_profile.merge_potential: For each positive directed boundary half-arc, count one potential activation if its endpoints have different canonical phase-one cut tags.
algorithm_profile.merge_order: Descending static potential score, then ascending unordered block-ID pair; union roots use the smaller block ID.
algorithm_profile.phase_two: For each component merge, re-solve that component from its original capacities using EIBFS; after all positive-capacity boundary pairs are merged, sum the flow values for the remaining disconnected components.
algorithm_profile.inner_solver: EIBFS two-forest pseudoflow growth, connector bottleneck pushes, excess/deficit draining, and round-robin orphan adoption. Every component solve starts a fresh EIBFS state; no prior pseudoflow balances, residual matrix, or search trees are carried between solves.
algorithm_profile.distinctness: The adjacent adaptive_bottom_up_graph_cut_merging package uses Edmonds-Karp and residual-region tags. The fcBK liusun entry is BK-backed; this profile uses EIBFS for every component flow solve.
algorithm_profile.maximum_result_derivation: At most 6 source terminal arcs, each with capacity at most 7, bound the total flow by 42.

oracle_method: Primary: deterministic adaptive component merges, EIBFS local component solves from original capacities, and canonical minimum-cut mask tags for merge priority. Independent: enumerate all source-side masks of the complete graph and minimize the directed cut capacity.

source.reuse: Algorithm descriptions only; the bounded deterministic restart profile is not the upstream parallel implementation.
